d:
The wait is finally over!
PHURR – the BIGGEST PARTY ANTHEM OF 2025 is here to make the world groove!
Experience the ultimate vibe as Kapil Sharma, Yo Yo Honey Singh and Josh Brar come together for an explosive track from the upcoming movie Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2 (KKPK 2).
From club nights to car rides — this track promises to make everything Phurr!
Turn it up loud, hit that play button, and feel the energy flow!
Song Title: PHURR
Featuring: Kapil Sharma, Tridha Choudhury ; Parul Gulati; Ayesha Khan
Singers: Yo Yo Honey Singh, Josh Brar
